description: This file defines Express.js routes for analytics-related endpoints in an employee management system backend. It sets up various GET routes for attendance summaries, project and task breakdowns, and leave statistics, applying authentication middleware and delegating request handling to controller functions.

methods.name: GET /analytics/attendance/summary
methods.description: Route handler for attendance summary, requires authentication and calls controller.attendanceSummary.

methods.name: GET /analytics/projects/tasks
methods.description: Route handler for project and task status breakdowns, requires authentication and calls controller.projectTaskBreakdown.

methods.name: GET /analytics/leaves/stats
methods.description: Route handler for leave statistics, requires authentication and calls controller.leaveStats.
